question: What claim about the transmission of the teaching is entailed by stating that it was told by an earth-mover concerning the earth-movers who are good eaters?
premises: A teaching concerning the earth-movers who are good eaters is referenced.
It was told by an earth-mover.
The address is to the beloved.
inference: The teaching concerning the good-eating earth-movers was disclosed by an earth-mover.
uncertainties: The verse does not distinguish whether one earth-mover speaks for a class or as an individual.
plain_english: The teaching of the earth-movers, the good eaters, was told by an earth-mover, O beloved.
